name: youtube-transcript
description: Extract YouTube captions and transcripts, summarize transcript files, and fall back to OpenAI audio transcription when needed.

interface.longDescription: A local content workflow plugin for extracting YouTube transcripts from captions, optionally falling back to OpenAI audio transcription, and summarizing YouTube or local transcript files.
defaultPrompt: Extract a transcript from this YouTube video.
Fetch captions only for this long YouTube video.
